principle: Frontmatter is document control plane; body remains knowledge payload; metadata cannot promote authority beyond source evidence.
hard_rules: OKF verified never collapses review_status, evidence_strength or interpretation_status.
Newest modified timestamp never decides authority by itself.
Historical and superseded records remain retrievable but cannot satisfy current-state queries unless explicitly requested.
Founder approval does not imply scientific or external verification.
Payment is not delivery; delivery is not outcome; outcome is not system impact.
Runtime observations require observed_at/effective_at and expire through freshness rules rather than being silently frozen into Canon.
Unknown or conflicting authority fails closed and creates a migration/validation exception.

stable_id.rule: Path or filename may be aliases but must not be the sole identity when a stable provider object ID exists.

storage_profiles.google_doc: embedded YAML control block at document start when content-safe; otherwise sidecar until reversible write is proven
storage_profiles.google_sheet: OKF registry/sidecar metadata; do not pretend spreadsheet cells are Markdown frontmatter
storage_profiles.google_slide: OKF registry/sidecar metadata; do not mutate slide content solely to simulate frontmatter
storage_profiles.folder: inventory node only; not a knowledge document unless explicitly classified
